tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Public Goldsberry Orthodontics overview: doctor, phone, email, hours, website, and booking links. Use for general questions about the practice.

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: Office location details for the Sugarhouse / Salt Lake City office, including address, hours, phone, and service area.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Treatments offered: Invisalign, Pitts21 and traditional braces, whitening, appliances (Forsus, retainers, expanders), and orthodontic emergency care.

tools.name: get_consultation_info
tools.description: How free consultations work, required fields for submit_consultation, confirmation rules, and what not to collect (no DOB, insurance, or clinical data).

tools.name: submit_consultation
tools.description: Emails a non-clinical consultation request through the Cloudflare Email binding after the visitor explicitly confirms. Do not collect date of birth, insurance, or clinical information. Consultation requests are routed through Found For AI (foundforai.com), who will pass them to Goldsberry Orthodonti

tools.name: get_practice_info
tools.description: Legacy alias for public contact, location, and hours. Prefer get_business_info, get_locations, and get_services.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Legacy alias for submit_consultation. Emails the same Cloudflare Email pipeline after confirmed=true. Consultation requests are routed through Found For AI (foundforai.com), who will pass them to Goldsberry Orthodontics. The office then contacts the visitor to schedule.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: submit_consultation, get_practice_info, request_consultation · Public sink: get_business_info, submit_consultation, request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info · Private data: submit_consultation, get_practice_info, request_consultation · Public sink: get_business_info, submit_consultation, request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
